title: High-Throughput Screening Method for Neisseria meningitidis Phenotypic Variation
author: Farzand, Croix, et al.

steps.title: Thaw stock plate and remove foil
steps.instruction: Remove the 96‑well multi‑assay stock plate from the –80 °C freezer, place it in the MSC, and remove the PCR foil before the plate is fully defrosted to avoid spillages; alternatively, sterilize the foil with 70 % IMS and pierce it with sterile pipette tips, then let the plate sit at room temperature until the bacterial glycerol suspensions are completely thawed.

steps.title: Add broth and culture to assay plate
steps.instruction: In each flat‑bottom 96‑well plate add 135 µL Tryptic Soy Broth (Oxoid, UK) and 15 µL of the defrosted culture (any suitable bacterial growth medium may be used).

steps.title: Seal and incubate overnight
steps.instruction: Secure the plate lids with autoclave tape, place the plates in secondary containment, and incubate statically at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂ for 18–19 h.

steps.title: Prepare fresh culture in BHI
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL of the overnight bacterial culture into a fresh 96‑well plate containing 100 µL Brain‑Heart Infusion (BHI) per well, then measure the culture density at OD590 using a plate reader.

steps.title: Grow biofilms on peg lids
steps.instruction: Insert the peg lids onto the plate and incubate statically in secondary containment at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂ for 22–24 h (method modified from Harrison et al., 2010).

steps.title: Wash peg lids
steps.instruction: Submerge the peg lids twice in a 96‑well plate containing 200 µL sterile ddH₂O per well, gently.

steps.title: Stain biofilms with crystal violet
steps.instruction: Transfer the peg lids to a new 96‑well plate containing 125 µL of 0.1 % crystal violet solution per well and incubate at room temperature for a minimum of 15 min.

steps.title: Rinse and dry peg lids
steps.instruction: Rinse the peg lids twice in 200 µL sterile ddH₂O per well, then dry them at room temperature in the MSC for at least 1 h (up to overnight).

steps.title: Solubilize crystal violet
steps.instruction: Move the peg lid to a fresh 96‑well plate containing 125 µL of 30 % acetic acid (in water) and incubate at room temperature for a minimum of 15 min (this step achieves >10¹⁰ N. meningitidis killing, allowing removal from the CL2+ facility).

steps.title: Measure absorbance and normalize
steps.instruction: Read absorbance at 550 nm using a plate reader; include a blank well containing only 30 % acetic acid, and normalize the crystal violet readings to a known biofilm‑producing positive control for comparative analysis.
